SELECT @rownum:=@rownum+1 as seqNo, (CASE WHEN a.ISSUER = null THEN a.ISSUER2 ELSE a.ISSUER END) ISSUER, (CASE WHEN a.FINANCIER = null THEN a.FINANCIER2 ELSE a.FINANCIER END) FINANCIER, (CASE WHEN a.MANAGER = null THEN a.MANAGER2 ELSE a.MANAGER END) MANAGER, (CASE WHEN a.SPONSOR = null THEN a.SPONSOR2 ELSE a.SPONSOR) SPONSOR, (CASE WHEN a.investAdviser = null THEN a.investAdviser2 ELSE a.investAdviser END) investAdviser, a.portfolioId, a.portfolioName, a.assetTypeOne, a.assetTypeTwo, a.assetTypeThree, a.assetTypeFour, a.assetTypeFive, a.assetId, a.assetName, a.assetType, a.amount, a.marketValue, a.cost, a.interestReceivable, (CASE WHEN a.marketValue = '-' THEN a.interestReceivable ELSE (CASE WHEN a.interestReceivable = '-' THEN a.marketValue ELSE a.marketValue+a.interestReceivable END) END) positionAll, a.diAmount, a.diMarketValue, a.diCost, a.diInterestReceivable, a.iiAmount, a.iiMarketValue, a.iiCost, a.iiInterestReceivable FROM (SELECT @rownum:=0) r, (SELECT (CASE WHEN t1.ISSUER =IFNULL(#{agencyId},0) THEN t1.ISSUER ELSE null END) ISSUER, (CASE WHEN t1.FINANCIER = IFNULL(#{agencyId},0) THEN t1.FINANCIER ELSE null END) FINANCIER, (CASE WHEN t1.MANAGER = IFNULL(#{agencyId},0) THEN t1.MANAGER ELSE null END) MANAGER, (CASE WHEN t1.SPONSOR =IFNULL(#{agencyId},0) THEN t1.SPONSOR ELSE null END) SPONSOR, (CASE WHEN t1.investAdviser =IFNULL(#{agencyId},0) THEN t1.investAdviser ELSE null END) investAdviser, (CASE WHEN t2.ISSUER =IFNULL(#{agencyId},0) THEN t2.ISSUER ELSE null END) ISSUER2, (CASE WHEN t2.FINANCIER =IFNULL(#{agencyId},0) THEN t2.FINANCIER ELSE null END) FINANCIER2, (CASE WHEN t2.MANAGER = IFNULL(#{agencyId},0) THEN t2.MANAGER ELSE null END) MANAGER2, (CASE WHEN t2.SPONSOR =IFNULL(#{agencyId},0) THEN t2.SPONSOR ELSE null END) SPONSOR2, (CASE WHEN t2.investAdviser =IFNULL(#{agencyId},0) THEN t2.investAdviser ELSE null END) investAdviser2, t1.portfolioId, t1.portfolioName, t1.assetTypeOne, t1.assetTypeTwo, t1.assetTypeThree, t1.assetTypeFour, t1.assetTypeFive, t1.finprodId as assetId, t1.finprodName as assetName, t1.finprodType as assetType, (CASE WHEN t1.amount = null THEN (CASE WHEN t2.amount = null THEN '-' ELSE t2.amount END) ELSE (CASE WHEN t2.amount =null THEN t1.amount ELSE t1.amount+t2.amount END) END) amount, (CASE WHEN t1.marketValue =null THEN (CASE WHEN t2.marketValue = null THEN '-' ELSE t2.marketValue END) ELSE (CASE WHEN t2.marketValue=null THEN t1.marketValue ELSE t1.marketValue+t2.marketValue END) END) marketValue, (CASE WHEN t1.cost = null THEN (CASE WHEN t2.cost =null THEN '-' ELSE t2.cost END) ELSE (CASE WHEN t2.cost =null THEN t1.cost ELSE t1.cost+t2.cost END) END) cost, (CASE WHEN t1.interestReceivable =null THEN (CASE WHEN t2.interestReceivable =null THEN '-' ELSE t2.interestReceivable END) ELSE(CASE WHEN t2.interestReceivable =null THEN t1.interestReceivable ELSE t1.interestReceivable+t2.interestReceivable END ) END) interestReceivable, (CASE WHEN t1.amount =null THEN '-' ELSE t1.amount END) as diAmount, (CASE WHEN t1.marketValue =null THEN '-' ELSE t1.marketValue END) as diMarketValue, (CASE WHEN t1.cost =null THEN '-' ELSE t1.cost END) as diCost, (CASE WHEN t1.interestReceivable =null THEN '-' ELSE t1.interestReceivable END) as diInterestReceivable, (CASE WHEN t2.amount =null THEN '-' ELSE t2.amount END) as iiAmount, (CASE WHEN t2.marketValue =null THEN '-' ELSE t2.marketValue END) as iiMarketValue, (CASE WHEN t2.cost =null THEN '-' ELSE t2.cost END) as iiCost, (CASE WHEN t2.interestReceivable =null THEN '-' ELSE t2.interestReceivable END) as iiInterestReceivable FROM ( SELECT holdShare.PORTFOLIO_ID as portfolioId, pp.PORTFOLIO_NAME as portfolioName, holdShare.FINPROD_ID as finprodId, holdShare.cost, holdShare.amount, holdShare.marketValue, holdShare.interestReceivable, fpt.TYPE_8 as assetTypeOne, fpt.TYPE_9 as assetTypeTwo, fpt.TYPE_10 as assetTypeThree, fpt.TYPE_11 as assetTypeFour, fpt.TYPE_12 as assetTypeFive, fp.FINPROD_NAME as finprodName, fp.FINPROD_TYPE as finprodType, fp.ISSUER, fp.FINANCIER, fp.MANAGER, fp.SPONSOR, fp.INVEST_ADVISER as investAdviser, fpt.UPDATE_TIME FROM (SELECT min(PORTFOLIO_ID) as PORTFOLIO_ID, --组合代码 FINPROD_ID, --金融产品代码 SUM(DSC_COST_AMT) as cost, --摊销总成本 直接投资成本 SUM(SHARE_AMT) as amount, --数量 直接投资数量 (CASE WHEN SUM(DSC_COST_AMT) = null THEN SUM(TDY_FLOAT_INGPL) ELSE (CASE WHEN SUM(TDY_FLOAT_INGPL) = null THEN SUM(DSC_COST_AMT ELSE SUM(DSC_COST_AMT+TDY_FLOAT_INGPL) END) END ) as marketValue, --摊销总成本+公允价值变动 直接投资市值
SUM(TDY_INTINCEXP) as interestReceivable --当日应计利息 直接投资应收利息 FROM PTL_SEC_VALUTION WHERE 1=1
AND CDATE = STR_TO_DATE(#{sysDate,jdbcType=VARCHAR},'%Y-%m-%d')
GROUP BY FINPROD_ID )holdShare --持仓表.组合代码 = 组合.组合代码 JOIN PTL_PORTFOLIO pp ON holdShare.PORTFOLIO_ID = pp.PORTFOLIO_ID --标的类金融产品表 ON 持仓表.金融产品代码 = 标的类金融产品表.金融产品代码 JOIN FIN_PRODUCT fp ON holdShare.FINPROD_ID = fp.FINPROD_ID --持仓表.金融产品代码 = 金融产品分类表.金融产品代码 JOIN FIN_PRODUCT_TYPE fpt ON holdShare.FINPROD_ID = fpt.FINPROD_ID WHERE 1=1
--发行人 AND (fp.ISSUER = #{agencyId,jdbcType=VARCHAR} --融资人 OR fp.FINANCIER = #{agencyId,jdbcType=VARCHAR} --管理人 OR fp.MANAGER = #{agencyId,jdbcType=VARCHAR} --担保人 OR fp.SPONSOR = #{agencyId,jdbcType=VARCHAR} --投资顾问 OR fp.INVEST_ADVISER = #{agencyId,jdbcType=VARCHAR} )
)t1 LEFT JOIN ( SELECT holdShare.PORTFOLIO_ID as portfolioId, pp.PORTFOLIO_NAME as portfolioName, holdShare.FINPROD_ID as finprodId, holdShare.cost, holdShare.amount, holdShare.marketValue, holdShare.interestReceivable, fpt.TYPE_8 as assetTypeOne, fpt.TYPE_9 as assetTypeTwo, fpt.TYPE_10 as assetTypeThree, fpt.TYPE_11 as assetTypeFour, fpt.TYPE_12 as assetTypeFive, fp.FINPROD_NAME as finprodName, fp.FINPROD_TYPE as finprodType, fp.ISSUER, fp.FINANCIER, fp.MANAGER, fp.SPONSOR, fp.INVEST_ADVISER as investAdviser FROM (SELECT min(PORTFOLIO_ID) as PORTFOLIO_ID, --组合代码 FINPROD_ID, --金融产品代码 SUM(DSC_COST_AMT) as cost, --摊销总成本 直接投资成本 SUM(SHARE_AMT) as amount, --数量 直接投资数量 SUM(DSC_COST_AMT) as marketValue, --摊销总成本+公允价值变动 直接投资市值 SUM(TDY_INTINCEXP) as interestReceivable --当日应计利息 直接投资应收利息 FROM PTL_SEC_PIERCE_VALUTION WHERE 1=1
AND CDATE = STR_TO_DATE(#{sysDate,jdbcType=VARCHAR},'%Y-%m-%d')
GROUP BY FINPROD_ID )holdShare --持仓表.组合代码 = 组合.组合代码 JOIN PTL_PORTFOLIO pp ON holdShare.PORTFOLIO_ID = pp.PORTFOLIO_ID --标的类金融产品表 ON 持仓表.金融产品代码 = 标的类金融产品表.金融产品代码 JOIN FIN_PRODUCT fp ON holdShare.FINPROD_ID = fp.FINPROD_ID --持仓表.金融产品代码 = 金融产品分类表.金融产品代码 JOIN FIN_PRODUCT_TYPE fpt ON holdShare.FINPROD_ID = fpt.FINPROD_ID WHERE 1=1
--发行人 and( fp.ISSUER = #{agencyId,jdbcType=VARCHAR} --融资人 OR fp.FINANCIER = #{agencyId,jdbcType=VARCHAR} --管理人 OR fp.MANAGER = #{agencyId,jdbcType=VARCHAR} --担保人 OR fp.SPONSOR = #{agencyId,jdbcType=VARCHAR} --投资顾问 OR fp.INVEST_ADVISER = #{agencyId,jdbcType=VARCHAR} )
)t2 on t1.portfolioId = t2.portfolioId and t1.finprodId = t2.finprodId ORDER BY t1.UPDATE_TIME DESC)a

SELECT DISTINCT res.id, (CASE WHEN mci.customer_name =null THEN res.id ELSE mci.customer_name END) text FROM ( SELECT DISTINCT fp.ISSUER id FROM PTL_SEC_POSITION psp LEFT JOIN FIN_PRODUCT fp ON psp.finprod_id = fp.finprod_id WHERE fp.ISSUER IS NOT NULL
UNION ALL
SELECT DISTINCT fp.FINANCIER id FROM PTL_SEC_POSITION psp LEFT JOIN FIN_PRODUCT fp ON psp.finprod_id = fp.finprod_id WHERE fp.FINANCIER IS NOT NULL
UNION ALL
SELECT DISTINCT fp.MANAGER id FROM PTL_SEC_POSITION psp LEFT JOIN FIN_PRODUCT fp ON psp.finprod_id = fp.finprod_id WHERE fp.MANAGER IS NOT NULL
UNION ALL
SELECT DISTINCT fp.SPONSOR id FROM PTL_SEC_POSITION psp LEFT JOIN FIN_PRODUCT fp ON psp.finprod_id = fp.finprod_id WHERE fp.SPONSOR IS NOT NULL
UNION ALL
SELECT DISTINCT fp.INVEST_ADVISER id FROM PTL_SEC_POSITION psp LEFT JOIN FIN_PRODUCT fp ON psp.finprod_id = fp.finprod_id WHERE fp.INVEST_ADVISER IS NOT NULL )res LEFT JOIN MST_CUSTOMER_INFO mci on res.id = mci.customer_id
AND (res.id like concat_ws('','%', #{agencyId,jdbcType=VARCHAR},'%') OR mci.customer_name like concat_ws('','%', #{agencyId,jdbcType=VARCHAR},'%'))
ORDER BY res.id

SELECT a.seqno, a.corOrgtype corOrgtype, a.corClass, a.pId, a.pName, a.id, a.name, b.ORG_NO AS agencyId FROM (SELECT ioc.seqno seqNo, ioc.cor_class corClass, ioc.COR_ORGTYPE AS corOrgtype, ioc.ORG_NO AS pId, mci2.customer_name AS pName, ioc.COR_ORGID AS id, IFNULL(mci.CUSTOMER_NAME, concat_ws('',ioc.EXECUTIVE_NAME , '(' , ioc.TITLE , ')')) AS name FROM INF_ORG_CORRELATION ioc LEFT JOIN MST_CUSTOMER_INFO mci ON ioc.cor_orgid = mci.customer_id LEFT JOIN MST_CUSTOMER_INFO mci2 ON ioc.ORG_NO = mci2.customer_id)a LEFT JOIN (SELECT ORG_NO FROM INF_ORG_CORRELATION GROUP BY ORG_NO) b on a.id = b.ORG_NO
AND a.pId = #{agencyId, jdbcType=VARCHAR}
